name: The King's Guild
description: Master artisans of the King's Guild each ply a different trade in a different quarter of the city. Work out who's who.
clues: Wulfric, Tanner, and Millpond belong to different artisans.
Aldric does not belong to the Ironmongers' Guild.
Beatrix goes with none of Fletcher, Highrow, or Kingsford.
Beatrix belongs to the Joiners' Guild.
Riverside goes with neither Beatrix nor Cedric.
The Mason and Wulfric are in different wards.
Beatrix and the Tanner are in different wards.
